episodes.logline: On her last night shift before transferring wards, Nurse Priya Nair notices a dose on a patient's chart that she never administered, and realises someone has been writing in her handwriting.
Priya takes the altered chart to the one colleague she trusts, and learns that the ward's night roster has been quietly rewritten to put her on shifts she never worked.
Priya tries to leave the hospital with the evidence on her phone, and finds that the only way out of the car park is past the man whose name is on every countersignature.
